title: Data for: DwarfJeansAnalysis production posteriors (Semi-analytic Inference of Satellite Densities in the Cold Dark Matter Model, Part II)
description:
Spherical-Jeans production posteriors for 39 Milky Way dwarf spheroidal galaxies under 8 prior configurations (312 runs; per run: posterior samples, derived quantities, summary table, audit and run log), produced by the DwarfJeansAnalysis code repository and accompanying the two-part paper series "Semi-analytic Inference of Satellite Densities in the Cold Dark Matter Model" (Part I: Comparison to Ultra-faint Dwarf Kinematics; Part II: Implications for Dark Matter Indirect Detection Constraints).

The single archive dja_production.tar.gz unpacks at the root of the DwarfJeansAnalysis repository (under results/production/) and is consumed by the SatelliteDensityInference repository.

See README_DATA.md and MANIFEST.json (per-file sha256, packing commit) in the record, and use scripts/zenodo_fetch.py in the code repository to download and unpack.
